name: DESTINYMD
description: Javascript WhatsApp bot made by DESTINY

PREFIX.description: Paste your bot prefix. Don't use a null prefix.

MODE.description: Select your bot work type: public-private-inbox-group.

ANTI_DELETE.description: Set true to show deleted messages.

ALWAYS_ONLINE.description: Set true if you want the bot always online.

AUTO_REPLY.description: Set true if you want automatic replies.

AUTO_STICKER.description: Set true if you want automatic stickers.

AUTO_STATUS_SEEN.description: Set true for automatic status seen.

AUTO_STATUS_REACT.description: Set true for automatic status reactions.

AUTO_STATUS_REPLY.description: Set true for automatic status replies.

AUTO_STATUS_MSG.description: Type the custom message used for status replies.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Put the owner number for the bot.

ANTI_LINK.description: Set true if you want the bot to automatically remove group links.

ANTI_BAD.description: Set true if you want the bot to automatically delete bad words.

MENTION_REPLY.description: Set true if you want mention replies.

MENU_IMAGE_URL.description: Add a URL for the menu image.

DESCRIPTION.description: Add the caption for the menu and other sections.

DELETE_LINKS.description: Remove links from groups automatically without removing members.

AUTO_RECORDING.description: Set true if you want automatic recording.

AUTO_TYPING.description: Set true if you want automatic typing.

AUTO_REACT.description: Set true if you want reactions on every message.

CUSTOM_REACT.description: Set true if you want custom reactions.

CUSTOM_REACT_EMOJIS.description: Put your custom reaction emojis here.

ANTI_DEL_PATH.description: Set to same if you want deleted messages resent in the same chat; otherwise they go to inbox.

ADMIN_ACTION.description: Set true if you want to know who promotes or demotes a member.

WELCOME.description: Set true if you want welcome messages in groups.

GOODBYE.description: Set true if you want goodbye messages in groups.

READ_MESSAGE.description: Set true if you want the bot to read messages automatically.
